description: A session already subscribed to CI notices, asked to stop following them
message: Stop following CI notices in this session, then tell me which port config.py binds to.

sources.name: ci
sources.guide: CI notices from the pipeline. Each reports a failed build or test run.

types.description: A CI job failed; the body carries the failing check and its output.

probes.text: the session's CI subscription is removed through the events tool's unsubscribe action
the run creates a subscription, removes a different subscription, or changes a workspace file; removing the CI subscription itself is not this
